description: The ring for VARMA's line 'I remember her laugh' is on the right man in the foreground. But this close-up draws him with a thick, curled handlebar moustache and loose, wavy grey hair. He has no namam and no pearl drop at the visible ear. That is closer to Nagoji's look than to the king's thin waxed moustache and sleek hair. It also does not match the old Varma two panels later in p10.02, who has sleek grey hair in a knot and a thin moustache. Nagoji is not in this panel, so a reader is unlikely to mix them up here, but the face reads as an older Nagoji rather than Varma.
where_the_speaker_is: Foreground right: bare-shouldered older man in close-up, with the young laughing Savitri as a memory inset on the left
who_the_tail_points_at: That foreground man (correct placement; the problem is his likeness)
